name: attach-multi-upload — 폴더 단위 첨부 · 드롭 이중처리 · 중복 스킵 요약 (authed, PB-0008 POST-DEPLOY)

steps.script: (async()=>{const mk=(n,c)=>new File([c],n,{type:'text/plain'});const dt=new DataTransfer();['amu_a.sql','amu_b.sql','amu_c.sql'].forEach((n,i)=>dt.items.add(mk(n,'-- amu test '+n+'\nSELECT '+(i+1)+';\n')));const el=document.getElementById('attachFileInput');el.files=dt.files;el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,6000));const t=document.getElementById('toast');const pills=document.querySelectorAll('#attachSidePanelList .attach-pill, #attachSidePanelList [class*=pill]');const srv=await (await fetch('/api/conversations/'+encodeURIComponent(window.__amuCid)+'/attachments')).json();return JSON.stringify({T2_toast:t?t.textContent:null,T2_toast_isError:t?(getComputedStyle(t).backgroundColor.indexOf('124')>=0):null,T2_pill_count:pills.length,T2_server_count:(srv.attachments||[]).length,T2_server_names:(srv.attachments||[]).map(a=>a.original_filename)});})()

(async()=>{const mk=(n,c)=>new File([c],n,{type:'text/plain'});const dt=new DataTransfer();['amu_a.sql','amu_b.sql','amu_c.sql'].forEach((n,i)=>dt.items.add(mk(n,'-- amu test '+n+'\nSELECT '+(i+1)+';\n')));const el=document.getElementById('attachFileInput');el.files=dt.files;el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,6000));const t=document.getElementById('toast');const srv=await (await fetch('/api/conversations/'+encodeURIComponent(window.__amuCid)+'/attachments')).json();return JSON.stringify({T3_toast:t?t.textContent:null,T3_toast_isError:t?(getComputedStyle(t).backgroundColor.indexOf('124')>=0):null,T3_server_count:(srv.attachments||[]).length});})()

(async()=>{const mk=(n,c)=>new File([c],n,{type:'text/plain'});const dt=new DataTransfer();['amu_d.sql','amu_e.sql','amu_f.sql'].forEach((n,i)=>dt.items.add(mk(n,'-- drop test '+n+'\nSELECT '+(i+10)+';\n')));const wrap=document.querySelector('.composer-wrap');const mkEv=(type)=>{const e=new DragEvent(type,{bubbles:true,cancelable:true,dataTransfer:dt});return e;};wrap.dispatchEvent(mkEv('dragenter'));wrap.dispatchEvent(mkEv('dragover'));wrap.dispatchEvent(mkEv('drop'));await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,7000));const t=document.getElementById('toast');const srv=await (await fetch('/api/conversations/'+encodeURIComponent(window.__amuCid)+'/attachments')).json();const names=(srv.attachments||[]).map(a=>a.original_filename);const dCount=names.filter(n=>n==='amu_d.sql').length;return JSON.stringify({T4_toast:t?t.textContent:null,T4_server_count:names.length,T4_names:names,T4_first_dropped_file_rows:dCount});})()

(async()=>{const dt=new DataTransfer();dt.items.add(new File(['-- single\nSELECT 99;\n'],'amu_single.sql',{type:'text/plain'}));const el=document.getElementById('attachFileInput');el.files=dt.files;el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,5000));const t=document.getElementById('toast');return JSON.stringify({T5_single_toast:t?t.textContent:null,T5_is_summary:t?/첨부 \d+개 중/.test(t.textContent):null});})()
